name: QunaSys Denmark
description: QunaSys Denmark ApS is the Danish subsidiary of Tokyo-headquartered QunaSys Inc., established August 2023 at the BioInnovation Institute's Deep Tech Lab Quantum in Copenhagen. As QunaSys's first overseas subsidiary, it leads Danish-funded quantum chemistry research projects. In 2025 it received a DKK 19M Innovation Fund Denmark grant for HyperTenQ, a four-year project with the University of Copenhagen and the Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme to develop quantum-enhanced chemical simulations for drug discovery.
headquarters: Copenhagen, Denmark (BII Deep Tech Lab Quantum)
highlights: First overseas subsidiary of QunaSys Inc. (Tokyo); Danish-incorporated ApS at BII Deep Tech Lab Quantum
DKK 19M Innovation Fund Denmark HyperTenQ grant (2025) with University of Copenhagen and NQCP
Quantum-enhanced chemical simulation focus targeting drug discovery applications
